sources.title: Google Search Central: Site Moves and Migrations
claims: Prepare a URL mapping from current addresses to new ones; identify URLs using sitemaps, analytics, server logs or the content system.

Google recommends relevant server-side permanent redirects when possible, avoiding chains and irrelevant redirects, checking redirects and canonical annotations, updating sitemaps, and retaining redirects generally at least one year.
Search visibility can fluctuate during a move; no ranking retention or improvement is promised.

status: Google primary guidance checked September24; practical mapping worksheet advice is editorial process guidance and makes no traffic or ranking promise.
